trigger.description: A client connection is accepted while the daemon is already shutting down — the shutdown latch flipped between accept() returning and the accept loop noticing (the shutdown wake connects to unblock accept, and a legitimate client can race in the same window). Instead of dropping the stream silently (which the client observes as a bare connection reset), run_accept_loop writes a framed daemon_shutting_down envelope before stopping so the client can fall back to the in-process path or retry against a fresh daemon.
trigger.invocation: Internal — exercised by write_shutting_down_response_emits_framed_daemon_shutting_down_envelope; the live path is the run_accept_loop shutdown branch.
